decisions.measured: Source main sheet planes at Z=0/1.6 mm; four 4.5 × 1.700012 mm receiving-section loops at Z=1.59.
decisions.mapping: Default handle/deckle sheet=1.6 mm. Handle tongue=4.4; total slot allowance .10 recreates 4.5 × 1.7 mm receiving section. Default .15 is a proposed FDM allowance, not measured or universal. Mould thickness 3.6–4.2 mm is original.

decisions.measured: Low source runner Z values .21/.22 mm; original not watertight with 27 edge-adjacent components.
decisions.mapping: Twelve original .4–.6 mm bed-aligned Boolean-unioned tabs, safe outboard cutting lanes and three carrier bays; no automatic repair or raw-mesh re-export.

decisions.originalDesign: Stepped screen mould with 2.4 mm registration lip, >=1.2 mm screen ledge, external .15–.40 mm screen allowance, loose gravity-seated deckle with .15–.40 mm PER SIDE clearance and 38–50 × 26–38 mm open paper aperture. Two adhesive tongue seats anchor a finger-holed upright handle outside the pocket.

decisions.assembly: Snip tabs, lower handle vertically into rear-wing slots and glue. Bond external screen perimeter to ledge, then lower deckle vertically. Reverse lift-off path before couching sheet. Sampled vertical paths, lateral deckle play, screen layer, open aperture and socket probes tested; gravity seating and glue explicitly disclosed, no claimed snap retention.

decisions.personalization: Closed 20×20 sampled image/text/icon/SVG heightfield, or exact validated convex STL, Boolean-subtracts front lug only. Continuous backing >=3.0 mm, no screen ledge or interface obstruction.

decisions.novelty: Both galleries checked. Existing Solar & Slot sundial caused rejection of initial solar idea. Unlike Sift & Sort graduated token deck, Wrap & Tuft horseshoes and lacing saddle, this kit forms a removable aperture boundary around an external paper-making screen; no repeated moving mechanism. Shared authored local studio/import/export validation infrastructure reused; all physical geometry redesigned.
